description: Use this when you need an exact loan APR or APY rather than an approximation. Two modes. mode="loan" (default): solve the true APR of an installment loan from amount financed, monthly payment, term, and upfront fees — Reg-Z style, fees discounted against the amount received, solved by Newton-Raphson. mode="rate": convert a nominal annual rate to APY for a given compounding frequency. Deterministic: same input, same output. Example: mode="loan", loanAmount=20000, monthlyPayment=450, termMonths=60, fees=500 -> apr=13.6301, totalInterest=7000. Prefer this over estimating APR/APY by hand.

mode.description: "rate" for nominal->APY, "loan" for loan APR (default loan).

nominalRate.description: [rate mode] Nominal annual rate as a percent.

name: apr_calc

apr.description: (loan mode) True annual percentage rate as a percent, rounded to 4 decimals.

apy.description: (rate mode) Annual percentage yield as a percent, rounded to 4 decimals.

compoundingPerYear.description: (rate mode) Compounding periods per year used for the APY.

monthlyRate.description: (loan mode) Periodic (monthly) rate as a percent, rounded to 6 decimals.

nominalRate.description: (rate mode) The nominal annual rate that was supplied, as a percent.

totalInterest.description: (loan mode) totalPaid minus loanAmount, rounded to cents.

totalPaid.description: (loan mode) monthlyPayment x termMonths, rounded to cents.

title: APR / APY Calculator
